name: Auto dealership
summary: New-vehicle franchised dealership (≈20,000–60,000 SF: glass showroom, offices, service drive, 12–35 service bays, parts) on 2–6 acres, most of which is paved display, inventory and customer parking. Building cost is moderate (pre-engineered/steel service shop under a premium OEM-image showroom), but the large paved site adds materially per building SF. Data are thin: RSMeans' 2019 model, two older completed projects and county assessment records; no recent public dealership budgets or OEM image-program cost disclosures were found in this session, so the baseline is a derived estimate in 2019 dollars.

typicalSize.method: Clark County WA dealerships 21,433–57,839 SF (d5); Classic Ford/Lincoln 67,152 SF with 34 bays (d6); Harwood Ford 25,000 SF with 14 bays (d7); RSMeans model 21,000 SF (d1). Mid 30,000 SF ≈ single-franchise store with ~20 bays.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Building SF per site acre from Clark County BOE records (d5): Subaru 34,528 SF / 1.95 ac = 17,700; Honda ~33,000 / 4.29 = 7,700; VW 21,433 / 2.55 = 8,400; CDJR 57,839 / 5.53 = 10,460; Kia 22,069 / 2.8 = 7,880. Median ≈ 8,400 → mid 8,500; low allows suburban stores with deep inventory lots.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Expressed in 2019 dollars (anchor year of the best evidence; build script escalates). RSMeans 2019 car dealership model: $131.10/SF total incl. 25% contractor fees and 7% architect → $122.52/SF building-only ex-architect (d1). Add site work for a dealership lot: ~3.5–4 SF of paved site per building SF (d5 median 8,400 SF/ac → ~5.2 SF of site per building SF, ~75% paved) × ~$12–16/SF for paving, storm, lighting and utilities (judgment, 2019) ≈ +$45–65/SF → $170–190/SF. Racine Hyundai 2017 $4.3M / 22,500 SF = $191/SF (d2, scope believed all-in). Colonial Honda 2005 $4.318M / 39,500 SF = $109/SF incl. site (d3, much older dollars, not used for mid). Online guide $91 (TX) – $134 (NY)/SF (d4, low confidence, building only). Mid $190 (2019 $); low $130 = RSMeans open-shop building + minimal site (pad on existing auto mall); high $280 = premium OEM image program (full-height glass showroom, ACM portal, polished floors) ≈ +45% (judgment — OEM image program cost disclosures not found). Verify against a current GMP.

scope.notes: Showroom, offices, service drive, service shop, parts, plus on-site paving for display/inventory/customer parking, storm, lighting and utilities. Excludes vehicle lifts and shop equipment (line item), furniture/IT/signage (ffe), land, soft costs, off-site work, impact/tap fees. Structured inventory parking excluded.

qualityTiers.method: economy = low/mid (130/190 ≈ 0.68); premium = high/mid (280/190 ≈ 1.47) moderated to 1.3 for mainstream brand image programs; luxury 1.6 for luxury-marque flagships (judgment).

systemSplit.method: Site (31–33) = 0.26 from the hard-cost build-up (≈$50 of $190/SF). Building 0.74 split with a pre-engineered/steel shop + glass showroom pattern: high 05 (steel frame), 08 (storefront curtain wall + overhead service doors), 03 (heavy shop slabs, trench drains). Not from a published elemental estimate.

lineItems.name: Service bay equipment (lifts, oil/air reels, exhaust extraction) per bay

cost.method: Derived: a two-post/four-post lift plus fluid/air reels and exhaust drops per bay (judgment). Cross-check: an online guide puts a 'mechanic/service station' equipment set at $115,000–$320,000 (d4). Qty default 20 bays (d6 34 bays/67k SF; d7 14 bays/25k SF; d2 12 bays/22.5k SF ≈ 1 bay per 1,500–2,000 SF).

lineItems.notes: Often purchased by the dealer, not the GC.

lineItems.name: In-bay automatic car wash / detail bay equipment

cost.method: Derived: dealerships commonly include a wash bay (d2, d3, d6 mention car washes); priced as an in-bay automatic system + reclaim (judgment; compare car-wash.json tunnel package, which is far larger).

lineItems.notes: Building shell for the wash bay is in the baseline; this is the equipment.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Furniture (showroom, offices, customer lounge), IT/AV and OEM signage per SF — judgment; not sourced. Verify with OEM image-program furniture packages.

pctOfHard.method: RSMeans carries 7% architectural fees on the dealership model (d1); add civil/survey/geotech, permits, testing, legal and OEM design-review costs → mid 12%.

softCosts.notes: Type-specific: OEM facility/image program design review and branded elements may be specified by the manufacturer; some OEMs offer facility incentive programs that offset cost (not modeled).

design.method: OEM image requirements evolve during design; judgment.

hard.method: Simple building types; judgment consistent with commercial norms.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Hard $130–280 × 1.09–1.18 soft ≈ $142–330; widened to $400 for luxury-marque flagships. 2019 dollars.

source.title: Construction Cost Estimates for Car Dealership in National, US (model page)

evidence.quote: Garage, Auto Sales with E.I.F.S. & Concrete Block / Rigid Steel … 21,000 SF … Total building cost $131.10 (union), incl. Contractor fees (25%) $24.51 and Architectural fees (7%) $8.58 per SF
evidence.scopeNotes: Value = $131.10 − $8.58 = $122.52/SF; building only, no site work or equipment; basic components; 2019 data. Open shop total $119.35.

evidence.quote: $4.3 million … 22,500 square feet … a service center with 12 bays
evidence.scopeNotes: ≈$191/SF; built Aug 2016–May 2017; includes alignment bay, car wash and detailing bay. Whether site work and equipment are included is not stated.

evidence.quote: 39,500 square foot new full service automobile dealership … Construction value: $4,318,000
evidence.scopeNotes: ≈$109/SF in 2004–05 dollars; includes earthwork, underground utilities, concrete and asphalt paving, vehicle display. Old — escalation-sensitive.

evidence.quote: The property was built in 1987 with 34,528 square feet … located on 1.95 acres. The property is divided into a showroom of 14,000 square feet, a service center of 8,600 square feet, a repair garage of 10,800 square feet
evidence.scopeNotes: Sizing only (depreciated assessed values are not construction costs). Other records: Honda ~33,000 SF on 4.29 ac; VW 21,433 SF on 2.55 ac; CDJR 57,839 SF on 5.53 ac; Kia 22,069 SF on 2.8 ac.
2012 new construction; 34 service bays, car wash, 36,642 SF service and parts area. No cost published.
Canadian project, sizing/program only: 5,700 SF showroom, 14 service bays, 2 detail bays, 1 wash bay. No cost published.

openQuestions: No recent (2023–2026) dealership construction cost with stated scope was found — web search quota was exhausted mid-session. Look for city staff reports on dealership incentive (sales-tax rebate) agreements, which often state construction investment, and OEM image-program cost reporting (Automotive News).
Site-work allowance per building SF is derived from assessment acreage, not a cost source.
Service-bay equipment, wash and FF&E are judgment values.
